recommend.rationale: Verdict: upheld (inconclusive). recommendAdmission: false. The pre-registration commit 61f6f8a9a (18:18:40Z) precedes the native run (18:18:53Z), the receipt (18:19:00Z) and the results commit 8ad06877c. The pinned protocol and fixture are the dev example files, unchanged since ff3ed46a3 (2026-10-26), and their digests match. The receipt validates. The executed Git version is 2.50.1 (Apple Git-155), confirmed on this host, while the documented version is 2.56.0, so the version-binding rule permits only inconclusive or execution_failed. On substance, git log -L traces line history, while Graft returns current code and callers and produced no historical evolution. The two serve complementary scopes, so this is not a challenger to Graft. Reject the lead rather than re-running at 2.56.0.

counterevidence.searched: Checked host git --version, receipt and request validity, the protocol and fixture digests and their first-add commits, and the graft target output for any line-history answer.

reexecution.notes: Not re-executed. A re-run is not required for a non-positive outcome, and this host still has Git 2.50.1, so it would carry the same version mismatch.
